part.text:
All tests pass. The fix enables `Router::new().fallback(get(fallback).fallback(not_found)).with_state(state)` without double `with_state` calls, mirroring tokio-rs/axum#1730:

- `axum/src/routing/route.rs` — added `InfallibleRouteFuture<B>`, a wrapper over `RouteFuture<B, Infallible>` that always yields a `Response` (unreachable `Err` handled with `match err {}`).
- `axum/src/routing/future.rs` — re-exported `InfallibleRouteFuture`.
- `axum/src/routing/method_routing.rs:1381` — implemented `Handler<(), S, B> for MethodRouter<S, B>` by delegating to `call_with_state`, so a `MethodRouter` requiring state can be passed to `Router::fallback` and receive state from the router's later `.with_state(...)` call.
- `axum/CHANGELOG.md` — changelog entry.

Validation: `cargo test -p axum` (268 lib tests incl. the new compile-check `method_router_fallback_with_state`, plus routing doctests), `cargo test -p axum-macros`, and `cargo test -p axum --tests` all pass. The only 4 failing doctests (`TypedHeader`/`axum::headers`) were verified pre-existing via `git stash`.
